summary: Targeted verification of scan-500 bug fix + VANDANA rebrand. Added 6 new scan/rebrand backend tests to backend_test.py — all pass. Sales/scan and Purchases/scan return HTTP 200 with JSON extraction for a valid JPG; garbage text file now returns 422 with a friendly 'detail' message (no more 500); empty file returns 400. pillow_heif is registered at import so HEIC/mobile photos decode without crashing. Frontend UI verified end-to-end: login screen shows VAN|DANA logo, PIN 112233 logs in, sidebar/topbar show VANDANA (no STEELBIZ text anywhere). On Sales page, SCAN BILL button opens file input; uploading a generated JPG (Ravi Traders / GI Pipe / 10 KG @ 100) triggers the LLM extraction and the Review dialog opens pre-filled (customer, item, qty, rate, total 1,000) with the CONFIRM SALE button and a 'Bill read — review and confirm' toast. Regression: PIN login, dashboard KPIs, and previously-fixed useEffect flows still working.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Scan endpoints and VANDANA rebrand are verified. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 6 scan-specific tests (sales+purchases: valid image 200, garbage 422, empty 400 for sales) and a settings-default assertion. The only failing pytest (test_purchase_and_sale_flow: out_before assertion) is due to accumulated TEST_CustFlow orphan sales in the DB, not a code regression.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original 500: resize_b64_png used Image.open(...).convert('RGB') in one chain and had no try/except; HEIC bytes from mobile photos hit PIL.UnidentifiedImageError and the endpoint returned 500. Fix: (1) register pillow_heif.register_heif_opener() at import so HEIC decodes; (2) split open() and convert() so decode errors are catchable; (3) wrap decode in scan_sale and scan_purchase in try/except that raises HTTPException 422 with a user-friendly detail. Verified with pytest and via live UI upload.
